prompt:
A desktop resume website, edge to edge, crisp type, no browser chrome and no desk. The page is one cotton visiting card seen once, filling the entire frame. The card's thick edge is the edge of the screen. Not a card floating on a background, not a photograph of a card on a table.

Debossed into the cotton, exact text: MOHD SOHEL DESHMUKH. Under it: Senior Software Engineer, Biz4Solutions, Pune. The email deshmukh.sohel@yahoo.com is set like a telephone number and is the only button, plainly pressable. Along the top of the card itself, small links: Home, Work, Contact. At the bottom of the same card, the record continues with one quieter line: Senior Programmer, Biz4Solutions, April 2022 – June 2025.

Visual law: warm cotton paper is the ground, charcoal ink is pressed into it, and one dull brass edge runs along the card. The signature is the deboss and the thickness. No portrait, no logo, no ornaments, no second accent.

A recruiter can read who he is and email him. Working page, not a poster.
